title: Who gets this right?
instruction: The principle of least privilege: each right goes only to the role that needs it for its job. Who gets which?

items.text: See their own payment and the trip programme
items.why: That is enough for every pupil.

items.text: Give someone the role of treasurer

items.why: The teacher changes the trip programme.
Every pupil signs up for themselves.

items.text: See the list of who hasn’t paid yet
items.why: The treasurer needs it to collect the money. The classmates don’t.

debrief: The admin can do everything, but that doesn’t mean they should do everything. Each right belongs to whoever needs it, and to nobody else.
